posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Your mouth contains over 700 species of bacteria.
Most are harmless — but the bad ones cause gum disease, cavities, and bad breath.

posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Your gut microbiome controls up to 30% of calories you absorb.
A healthy gut means better weight management.
posts.cta: Fix your gut, fix your weight.
